title: Benefit Overpayment Accounts — Keeping a Changed Plan to Its Running Schedule
content:
When the installment of a current repayment plan on Benefit Overpayment Accounts is changed, the changed plan keeps to the schedule already running, and the months taken off the changed-plan months for it are found according to where the plan stands.

| Where the plan stands | Months taken off |
|---|---|
| The plan's first installment due date has passed and no waiver request was lodged on the overpayment after that date | The installments already fallen due: the whole months from the first installment due date to the handling date, plus one for the first installment |
| The plan's first installment due date has passed and a waiver request was lodged on the overpayment after that date | Billing stopped for the review, so only the installments fallen due before the review: the whole months from the first installment due date to the latest waiver request date, plus one for the first installment |
| The plan's first installment due date has not yet passed | The plan is held to the determination's clock instead: the whole months from the determination date to the handling date, never more than 6 (the determination-months cap) |

## Interpretive points

- The first installment due date has passed when it is earlier than the handling date. On the due date itself it has not yet passed.
- A waiver request was lodged after the first installment due date when its date received is later than that due date. The latest waiver request date is the date received of the request lodged on the overpayment with the latest date received.
- The cap of 6 applies only in the third row.

## Hypothetical cases

| First installment due | Latest waiver request received | Determination date | Handling date | Months taken off |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 15 January | None, or 2 January | — | 20 May | 4 whole months, plus one: 5 |
| 15 January | 20 March | — | 20 May | 2 whole months to 20 March, plus one: 3 |
| 15 June | — | 1 March | 20 May | 2 whole months |
| 15 June | — | 1 March of the previous year | 20 May | 14 whole months, capped at 6 |
